about: Triggering + error-class evals (A9). validate-shopify is a read-only checker of theme JSON (templates, section schemas, settings_data.json); it does not write files.

cases.prompt: validate the section schemas before I push the theme
actually change the colors in the theme

errorClassCases.fixture: a range setting with (max-min) not divisible by step
a select setting with more than 50 options
a section referencing a block type whose file is missing
a template referencing a color_scheme id absent from settings_data.json
a setting id referenced in liquid but not defined in the schema
